scientific_integrity: Analytical proof includes the strict Cauchy-Schwarz step, partial fractions and renewal identities; finite-difference tests are supporting evidence, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Ideal point absorption on a finite circle, uniform initial/reset sites, instantaneous independent Poisson resets. A full priority audit is not performed, and a source theorem may imply the specialized comparison. The strict unreset-between-protocols result is only asserted for this exactly uniform circle. Laplace order is not first-order stochastic dominance.
title: Opposite global resetting optima for fresh and persistent uniform anchors on a Brownian circle
